name: write-architecture-docs
tagline_zh: 当代码已跑通、文档却还停在石器时代，用这个 Skill 把散落的 ADR 和架构笔记重写成团队看得懂的现代蓝图。
tagline_en: When code is ahead of docs, this Skill rewrites scattered ADRs into a clear architecture blueprint—even knowing.
desc_en: Write or rewrite architecture subsystem docs, ADRs, and reference material for the engineering team. Use when creating, updating, or reviewing docs under docs/architecture docs/, or when the user asks you to write documentation that describes the system's design.
why_zh: 它不只是模板填充，而是基于 Prisma 真实仓库的文档结构，自动对齐 ADR 格式与术语。
why_en: It doesn't just fill templates—it aligns with Prisma's actual doc structure and ADR conventions, saving you from guessing style.
